rules: Filters remove records with quality flags in {0,1,2,3} indicating invalid data; values are clamped to [0,100] for temperature and pressure; interpolation occurs only within gaps of under forty minutes and flags the gap as corrected; all units are normalized to SI with explicit labels.
invariants: Output tables must have exactly one row per station per month, with no missing or duplicated entries; all numeric values are validated against unit labels and domain constants; total records after filtering match sum of valid inputs across stations.
